item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary: Establish the Python project and parser integration boundaries.
type: foundational
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: ARCHITECTURE.md
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: Python project foundation
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Establish the Python 3 project, standard-library-only runtime, environment and test runner
  described by TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md. Define the document tree and parser integration boundaries.
  Stage spec.txt, spec_tests.py, cmark.py, normalize.py, and full_test.sh verbatim under sources/.
  Provide a runnable integration point for the executable without claiming parser conformance.
  Preserve the supplied assets and follow the specification's two-phase parsing strategy.

## story delivery
summary: Provide the standard-stream executable.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Executable.md
covers: DELIVERY-001
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: commonmark
consumes: Python project foundation
depends: foundation
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Provide the executable ./commonmark at the application root. Read UTF-8 Markdown from
  standard input and write rendered HTML to standard output through the parser integration point.
  Create the concise project README required by the imported instructions. Establish the runner's
  program interface before scoped conformance checks.

## story paragraphs
summary: Form paragraphs and handle blank lines.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Paragraphs.md
covers: BLOCKS-008
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: paragraph block parsing
consumes: commonmark
depends: delivery
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement paragraph formation, continuation, whitespace handling, and blank-line separation
  according to the specification. Preserve raw inline content for the subsequent inline phase.
  Gate the complete Paragraphs and Blank lines sections when their cross-feature prerequisites
  are available; use a direct block interface check for this increment.

## story thematic-breaks
summary: Recognize thematic breaks with block precedence.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-ThematicBreaks.md
covers: BLOCKS-001
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: thematic break parsing
consumes: paragraph block parsing
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Recognize matching runs of at least three permitted markers with the specified indentation
  and whitespace. Apply paragraph interruption and precedence against setext underlines and list
  items. Check the capability directly until the interacting block and inline providers exist.

## story atx-headings
summary: Parse ATX headings.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-ATXHeadings.md
covers: BLOCKS-002
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: ATX heading parsing
consumes: paragraph block parsing
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Parse one through six opening markers, optional closing markers, indentation and whitespace,
  retaining heading text for inline parsing. Check the block interface directly until interacting
  code, inline and container capabilities exist.

## story setext-headings
summary: Parse setext headings.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-SetextHeadings.md
covers: BLOCKS-003
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: setext heading parsing
consumes: paragraph block parsing, thematic break parsing
depends: paragraphs, thematic-breaks
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Convert eligible paragraph lines followed by a valid underline into headings, observing
  precedence, indentation, lazy continuation and nonempty-content rules. Retain text for inline
  parsing and check the block interface directly until interacting providers exist.

## story indented-code
summary: Parse indented code blocks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-IndentedCode.md
covers: BLOCKS-004
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: indented code block parsing
consumes: paragraph block parsing
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Parse indented chunks and intervening blank lines, respecting four-column indentation,
  paragraph interruption, literal content and trailing blank-line rules. Check the block
  interface directly until interacting container and block providers exist.

## story fenced-code
summary: Parse fenced code blocks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-FencedCode.md
covers: BLOCKS-005
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: fenced code block parsing
consumes: paragraph block parsing
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Parse backtick and tilde fences, matching closing fences, indentation, unclosed blocks and
  info strings. Preserve literal code and render the first info word as the language class.
  Check the block interface directly until interacting inline and container providers exist.

## story html-blocks
summary: Parse raw HTML blocks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-HTMLBlocks.md
covers: BLOCKS-006
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: HTML block parsing
consumes: paragraph block parsing
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement the seven specified HTML block start and end conditions, interruption rules and
  container termination, preserving block content as raw HTML. Check the block interface directly
  until interacting inline and container providers exist.

## story reference-definitions
summary: Collect document-wide link reference definitions.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-ReferenceDefinitions.md
covers: BLOCKS-007
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: document reference map
consumes: paragraph block parsing
depends: paragraphs
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Extract valid definitions when paragraphs close, including definitions in containers, and
  retain the first definition for each normalized label. Expose the completed document-wide map
  to inline parsing. Check the definition interface directly until link and container providers
  exist.

## story block-quotes
summary: Parse block quote containers.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-BlockQuotes.md
covers: CONTAINERS-001
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: block quote parsing
consumes: paragraph block parsing, thematic break parsing, ATX heading parsing, setext heading parsing, indented code block parsing, fenced code block parsing, HTML block parsing, document reference map
depends: paragraphs, thematic-breaks, atx-headings, setext-headings, indented-code, fenced-code, html-blocks, reference-definitions
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Extend the block tree with nested block quotes, continuation markers and valid lazy paragraph
  continuations. Apply the specification's container closure rules. Check the block interface
  directly until lists and inline providers exist.

## story lists
summary: Parse list items and lists.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Lists.md
covers: CONTAINERS-002
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: list block parsing
consumes: block quote parsing, paragraph block parsing, thematic break parsing, ATX heading parsing, setext heading parsing, indented code block parsing, fenced code block parsing, HTML block parsing, document reference map
depends: block-quotes
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement list marker classification, item indentation and continuation, nesting, empty items,
  interruption, list grouping, start numbers and tight or loose rendering. Preserve the block
  tree and document-wide references. Check the block interface directly until inline providers
  exist.

## story inline-text
summary: Parse escapes, character references, and text line breaks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-InlineText.md
covers: INLINES-007
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: inline text parsing
consumes: list block parsing, document reference map
depends: lists
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  After block parsing and reference collection, handle ASCII punctuation escapes, valid named
  and numeric references, ordinary text and soft breaks as specified. Preserve the literal
  behavior of code and raw HTML contexts. Check the inline interface directly until interacting
  inline constructs exist.

## story code-spans
summary: Parse inline code spans.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-CodeSpans.md
covers: INLINES-001
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: code span parsing
consumes: inline text parsing
depends: inline-text
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Match equal-length backtick runs, normalize line endings and the specified paired spaces,
  preserve literal contents, and honor precedence against other inline constructs. Check the
  inline interface directly until all interacting constructs exist.

## story emphasis
summary: Parse emphasis and strong emphasis.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Emphasis.md
covers: INLINES-002
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: emphasis parsing
consumes: inline text parsing, code span parsing
depends: code-spans
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement the specification's delimiter-stack algorithm, Unicode flanking rules, rule of
  three, nesting and precedence for emphasis and strong emphasis. Check the inline interface
  directly until link, image, autolink and raw HTML providers exist.

## story links
summary: Parse inline and reference links.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Links.md
covers: INLINES-003
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: link parsing
consumes: document reference map, inline text parsing, code span parsing, emphasis parsing
depends: emphasis, reference-definitions
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement inline, full, collapsed and shortcut links, destination and title parsing, label
  normalization and reference lookup. Use the specified delimiter-stack procedure and prevent
  nested links while honoring inline precedence. Check the interface directly until the remaining
  interacting inline providers exist.

## story images
summary: Parse inline and reference images.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Images.md
covers: INLINES-004
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: image parsing
consumes: link parsing
depends: links
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Implement inline and reference image forms using the link parsing rules, allowing links and
  images in descriptions and rendering their plain textual content as alt text. Check the
  interface directly until the remaining interacting inline providers exist.

## story autolinks
summary: Parse URI and email autolinks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Autolinks.md
covers: INLINES-005
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: autolink parsing
consumes: inline text parsing, code span parsing
depends: code-spans
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Recognize the specified absolute URI schemes and email forms within angle brackets, apply
  their literal and escaping rules, and render their destinations and labels. Check the inline
  interface directly until all interacting inline providers exist.

## story inline-html-breaks
summary: Parse raw inline HTML and hard line breaks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-InlineHTMLBreaks.md
covers: INLINES-006
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: inline HTML and hard break parsing
consumes: inline text parsing, code span parsing
depends: code-spans
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Recognize the specified inline HTML grammar and preserve valid raw tags. Render hard breaks
  from the specified spaces or backslash before a line ending, excluding code spans, HTML tags
  and block endings. Check the inline interface directly until all interacting providers exist.

## story conformance-integration
summary: Exercise all scoped CommonMark examples against the integrated parser.
type: service
kind: integration
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-ConformanceIntegration.md
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: integrated CommonMark parser
consumes: commonmark, list block parsing, image parsing, autolink parsing, inline HTML and hard break parsing
depends: delivery, lists, images, autolinks, inline-html-breaks
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Assemble block parsing, document-wide reference resolution, inline parsing and HTML rendering.
  Run the supplied spec_tests.py using explicit --pattern selectors with --dump-tests as the
  JSON probe. Execute every example-owning section in scoped checks, including Tabs and
  Precedence, as well as all sections assigned to the parser capabilities. Each selector must
  cover its complete section and never invoke full_test.sh. Preserve the staged assets verbatim.

## story verification
summary: Verify the complete supplied conformance suite.
type: service
kind: test harness
phase: 1
implements: VERIFICATION.md
covers: VERIFICATION-001
accepts: st-001
stack: common.md, python.md
consumes: integrated CommonMark parser
depends: conformance-integration
acceptance: yes
instructions: |
  Run the sole terminal Suite: full criterion with sh sources/full_test.sh. Print captured
  stdout and stderr and assert only that its return code is zero. Do not modify the supplied
  scoring entry point or its assets.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
